purpose: run the public chat template and compare its behavior with the existing fixed Mux build

template.generation: supported new.mjs chat command with explicit framework path; no authored-source edits
observations: loaded earlier history through the options menu
history scrolled before Home; the Home screen was verified visually
return preserved the same navigation identities and history position; subsequent downward finger path moved from history rows 218-228 to 195-206
a second return with the keyboard open preserved the draft; a subsequent drag moved to history rows 230-236
rightward message swipe opened Replying to; Cancel reply removed it
raw left-edge swipe returned to Chats after keyboard dismissal

mux.artifact: existing fixed simulator build from app ce24795 with Exact 6f4917bda
mux.accountScope: designated test account only, signed out at completion
observations: inbox scrolled to older test-room rows after Home return and scrolled back to the top
a test chat scrolled to older messages after a separate Home return
raw left-edge swipe returned to the inbox
partial horizontal row drag exposed Archive and Mute; neither action was invoked
mux.automationLimit: two composer fill attempts returned TEXT_ENTRY_MISMATCH with an empty field, including the suggested delayed retry; no message was sent and composer text entry is not claimed validated in this comparison

conclusions: both products use a virtualized appearance-none transcript starting at and following the end
template explicitly requests interactive keyboard dismissal; the current framework already defaults vertical scrollers to interactive, which Mux inherits
the template uses native route chrome, fake data, three inbox contacts and explicit history loading; Mux uses custom glass chrome, live Matrix data and reach-start pagination
the template pin has no TimerScrollTouch; this is a product comparison, not an isolated runtime A/B
no complete scrolling freeze reproduced; no frame-rate or hitch comparison was measured
Home commands do not reproduce the physical touch-cancellation path of the original Home-indicator swipe
no app or framework production source changed
